name: Query Binder
description: Semantic analysis stage that consumes the parsed AST and produces a fully bound AST: resolves names against the catalog, enforces type rules, handles scoping for subqueries and WITH clauses, rewrites syntactic sugar, and rejects semantically invalid queries with descriptive errors.

name: C API
description: C language binding layer in `src/c_api/` that exposes a flat, ABI-stable C interface over the public C++ API; enables FFI integration from languages that cannot directly consume C++ (Rust, Python ctypes, etc.) and is the substrate for the Rust API binding.

name: Catalog
description: In-memory schema metadata registry that tracks all node tables, relationship tables, property definitions, scalar macro functions, sequences, and type information; provides the authoritative source of truth for name resolution during binding and for physical plan construction during processing.

name: Common Utilities
description: Cross-cutting foundation library providing shared data types (including all scalar, temporal, nested, and graph-specific types), value representation, vectorized data chunks, null masks, Arrow format interop, filesystem abstraction, task scheduler, serialization/deserialization, exception handling, and miscellaneous utilities used by every other subsystem.

name: Expression Evaluator
description: Vectorized expression evaluation layer that executes bound expression trees against columnar data chunks at runtime; supports scalar function evaluation, literal constants, column references, CASE expressions, lambda expressions, list/path/pattern comprehensions, and expression tree compilation.

name: Extension Runtime
description: Extension lifecycle management subsystem responsible for discovering, downloading, verifying, loading, and unloading dynamically linked extension shared libraries; manages the extension catalog entries, version compatibility checks, and the generated loader stubs that wire extensions into the engine at startup.

name: Bundled Extensions
description: Collection of 15 loadable extension plugins shipped with Kuzu, organized into four categories: (1) graph/search — `algo` (graph algorithms), `fts` (full-text search), `vector` (vector similarity index); (2) external DB connectors — `duckdb`, `postgres`, `sqlite`, `neo4j`; (3) cloud/format connectors — `httpfs`, `azure`, `delta`, `iceberg`, `json`, `unity_catalog`; (4) AI — `llm`.

name: Function Library
description: Registry and implementation of all built-in scalar, aggregate, and table functions: arithmetic, comparison, string, date/timestamp/interval, cast, list, map, struct, union, blob, UUID, hash, path, sequence, and null functions; also includes the function resolution and overload dispatch mechanism.

name: Graph Analytics
description: Graph data model abstractions and generalized data science (GDS) algorithm runtime: defines graph entry sets and on-disk graph representations used as algorithm inputs, and implements GDS table functions (shortest path, PageRank, BFS, community detection, etc.) that execute over those graph representations.

name: Language Bindings
description: Language-specific client wrappers and the interactive CLI shell: Python API (pybind11, `tools/python_api/`), Java API (JNI, `tools/java_api/`), Node.js API (native addon, `tools/nodejs_api/`), Rust API (FFI crate over C API, `tools/rust_api/`), WebAssembly build (Emscripten, `tools/wasm/`), and the interactive Cypher shell with linenoise (`tools/shell/`).

name: Query Optimizer
description: Logical plan rewriting subsystem that applies a sequence of rule-based and cost-guided optimizer passes including filter push-down, projection push-down, limit push-down, factorization rewriting, hash join acceleration, correlated subquery unnesting, and removal of unnecessary joins.

name: Query Parser
description: ANTLR4-based Cypher query parser comprising the Cypher.g4 grammar, a generated lexer/parser, and a transformer that converts raw Cypher query strings into a parsed (unbound) AST of statement and expression nodes.

name: Query Planner
description: Logical query plan generator that takes a bound AST and produces a tree of logical operators; enumerates candidate join orders using dynamic programming, selects plans based on cardinality estimates, and handles subquery unnesting and multi-part query planning.

name: Query Processor
description: Vectorized physical query execution engine that compiles an optimized logical plan into a pipeline of physical operators (scan, hash join, aggregate, order-by, recursive extend, DML insert/delete/set, batch copy, index lookup, cross product, etc.) and executes them using a morsel-driven parallel scheduler.

name: Public C++ API
description: User-facing C++ API surface (the `kuzu` namespace in `src/main/`) providing the Database, Connection, PreparedStatement, QueryResult, and QuerySummary classes; the stable entry point for embedding Kuzu in C++ applications and the foundation that all language bindings wrap.

name: Storage Engine
description: Columnar disk-based storage subsystem providing buffer management, page I/O with shadow-file durability, write-ahead logging (WAL) and checkpointing, column chunk encoding and compression (bitpacking, ALP float, dictionary, RLE), node and relationship table storage, hash and B-tree indices, local (uncommitted) storage for in-progress transactions, and per-table statistics.

name: Test Infrastructure
description: Google Test-based testing framework and test corpus: a test runner that parses and executes `.cypher` end-to-end test files against expected answers, component-level C++ unit test suites for storage/transaction/binder/planner/optimizer, API-level tests, copy/import tests, and shared test helper utilities; provides the executable specification of system correctness.

name: Transaction Manager
description: ACID transaction lifecycle subsystem managing transaction creation, commit, rollback, and concurrency control; maintains per-transaction undo buffers for write visibility, coordinates with the storage engine's WAL for durability, and enforces snapshot isolation semantics.
